lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ひなちゃん、昔の人形、本当、綺麗。
lines.en: Hina-chan, these old dolls are really beautiful.
lines.style: Soft, unhurried opening. Warm recognition threading through each word. Gentle pause after the name — tenderness for the child. Voice settles into nostalgia, like turning pages of memory. Low, present presence.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Immediate bright joy, no hesitation. Open mouth on the opening vowel. Genuine delight — not performed. Leaning forward in voice. Quick, but not rushed. Warmth meeting wonder.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 優しい、おばあちゃんから、もらった。
lines.en: My grandmother gave them to me — they're so precious.
lines.style: Shift into tender memory. Slow pace, almost reverent. Slight catch of emotion on 'gave' — not sad, but weighted with love. Voice softens further. Trailing off slightly, like setting something fragile down.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Quiet confirmation, seeking agreement. High and clear but gentle — not loud. Small smile audible. Slight lift at the end, turning to grandma. Genuine realization, not performance.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.en: Being together like this — it's really fun, isn't it.
lines.style: Warm, settled contentment. Slow, luxurious pace — savoring the moment. Soft exhale underneath. No urgency. Like she's speaking the feeling into the room to make it last longer.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Genuine, simple gratitude. Steady delivery — not gushing, but sincere. Child's voice rising slightly with earnestness. Direct eye contact in tone. Small and real.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.style: Soft promise, almost a prayer. Holding the moment gently. Slow, deliberate. Weight of continuity underneath — not loss, but the wish for preservation. Voice settles into quiet certainty.
